description: This file defines a PHP class 'SocialMediaAuthenticationController' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling social media authentication within the OpenID authentication plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a component for the authentication provider list during pre-rendering.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationController
classes.description: A controller handling social media authentication related actions within the OpenID plugin, responsible for preparing the authentication provider list component during the pre-render phase.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to initialize and set the 'auth-provider-list' component before rendering the view.
